title: Erlang Cowboy order list handler
context: Cowboy handler for GET /orders?status=...&limit=N. auth:user_id(Req) returns {ok, UserId} for signed-in users or error; users see only their own orders. limit defaults to 50 and must be clamped to 1..200; a non-numeric limit must give 400, not a crash. db:equery/2 runs a parameterised Postgres query and returns {ok, Columns, Rows}.
code: Sql = "SELECT id, total_cents, status FROM orders WHERE user_id = $1 AND status = '"
++ binary_to_list(Status) ++ "' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $2",

expected.why: a non-numeric limit raises badarg and the request ends in a 500 instead of a 400
max/2 turns every limit into at least 200 instead of clamping it to 1..200
status from the query string is concatenated into the SQL (injection); it must be passed as a bound parameter
